record.question: _________ may be used in cases of minor nature where the duration of hospitalisation is less than 48 hours.
record.explanation: Answer A: Short stay medical record. A short-stay medical record is used for brief hospitalizations, such as stays under 48 hours, where a shorter record format is appropriate. Source/context note: Use of special short-stay forms is a legacy/local paper-record practice. Reference: https://iris.who.int/bitstream/handle/10665/208125/9290610050_rev_eng.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
